text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v3
        with:
          version: v1.54
          args: --timeout=5m

  build-and-test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Format
        run: |
          gofmt -w .
          if [[ $(git diff --name-only) ]]; then
            echo "Code is not formatted correctly"
            git diff
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: go build -v ./...

      - name: Test
        run: go test -v ./...
```
